title: Check If Move Is Legal
statement:
Given an 8-by-8 Reversi board, an empty cell `(rMove, cMove)`, and a color, return whether placing that color there is legal. A move is legal if at least one of the eight straight or diagonal directions has one or more opponent pieces followed by a piece of the chosen color.

## Examples

```text
Input: board = [[".", ".", ".", "B", ".", ".", ".", "."], [".", ".", ".", "W", ".", ".", ".", "."], [".", ".", ".", "W", ".", ".", ".", "."], [".", ".", ".", "W", ".", ".", ".", "."], [".", ".", ".", ".", ".", ".", ".", "."], [".", ".", ".", ".", ".", ".", ".", "."], [".", ".", ".", ".", ".", ".", ".", "."], [".", ".", ".", ".", ".", ".", ".", "."]], rMove = 4, cMove = 3, color = "B"
Output: true
```

## Constraints

- `board` is an 8-by-8 matrix containing `B`, `W`, or `.`.
- The chosen cell is empty.
- `color` is `B` or `W`.
